svg.aria-label: A push to your GitHub repository runs Alchemy in GitHub Actions. Alchemy deploys to your Convex team: production and one preview per pull request, each serving the backend and the site. The identity hub gives each deployment its own sign-in client. samebase.com reads the Alchemy state and shows what is deployed.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
